story_sequence.text: The default implement task prompt includes existing root-level `DESIGN.md` as project-level design truth.
The default implement task prompt includes existing root-level `PRODUCT.md` as project-level product truth.
Missing `DESIGN.md` or `PRODUCT.md` does not block prompt generation.
The prompt distinguishes project-level product/design truth from frozen PRD/user-story/test-case requirement truth.
The prompt requires an AC coverage matrix before QA handoff.
The AC coverage matrix records each AC as `pass`, `partial`, or `blocked`.
Each AC coverage row includes evidence or a blocking note.
Simple, team, and ralph remain implement modes under `beacon-implement`; no new public implement mode skill is introduced.
Tests cover project truth injection and AC coverage matrix wording.
This change stays anchored to `build_default_task_prompt`; team-worker injection and ralph baseline hash enforcement are not included.
